title: A $(\log n)^{1/4}$ Bound for the Komlós Problem
summary: Let $A\in\mathbb{R}^{m\times n}$ have columns of Euclidean norm at most one. We prove that $\operatorname{disc}(A)\le2395\left(1+\log_+\frac n9\right)^{1/4}+2\sqrt2$. Here $\log_+t=\max\{0,\log t\}$. Building on Bansal and Jiang's affine spectral independence framework, we remove the $(\log\log n)^{7/4}$ factor from their bound. The fourth root comes from balancing the logarithmic decrease in the alive dimension against the fourth power of the row thresholds.
